# create-api-kit

> A CLI that scaffolds secure REST APIs with Express and TypeScript, with optional PostgreSQL and optional OpenAPI/Swagger UI plus Zod.

## Project

- Repository: https://github.com/GutoVargas/create-api-kit
- Install/run: `npx create-api-kit`
- Minimum Node.js version: 20

## What it generates

- An Express and TypeScript API with security middleware and a documented folder structure.
- Optional PostgreSQL persistence, SQL migrations, CRUD example, and request journal.
- Optional OpenAPI specification, Swagger UI at `/docs`, and Zod validation.
- Disabled integrations are removed from the generated project, including their dependencies.

## Quick start

```sh
npx create-api-kit
cd <project-folder>
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up --build
```

For PostgreSQL projects, set `DB_PASSWORD` in `.env`. CORS blocks origins by default; configure `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` to allow trusted browser origins. Without PostgreSQL, the generated Compose file starts only the API. Without OpenAPI, Swagger and Zod are not installed.
